text:
anya: Heads up, trying out the new nextjs-llama-starter (browser wasm variant) and hit a couple onboarding bumps. Anyone who recently touched the starter?
chris: what's happening?
anya: On local Edge-like envs and Vercel Edge, the starter crashes while loading wasm: 
```
TypeError: WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming is not a function
    at wasmLoader (/lib/wasm.js:12:15)
```
anya: The starter uses instantiateStreaming to speed up startup. Node fallback to arrayBuffer is present, but Edge runtimes in some infra don't expose instantiateStreaming and also don't have global TextEncoder/TextDecoder.
leo: Ugh, those subtle runtime differences. Starter should detect 'typeof WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming === "function"' and fall back cleanly. Also need to guard for missing TextEncoder/TextDecoder.
tess: Could we move tokenization/encoding into an API route (server) by default so the browser edge worker stays tiny? That would avoid polyfills in a lot of places.
anya: I tried a quick patch: 
```js
const res = await fetch(modelUrl);
let instance;
if (typeof WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming === 'function') {
  instance = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(res, imports);
} else {
  const buf = await res.arrayBuffer();
  instance = await WebAssembly.instantiate(buf, imports);
}
```
anya: That fixed instantiateStreaming errors but then tokenizer code threw: "ReferenceError: TextEncoder is not defined" in the edge handler. Polyfilling helped, but felt hacky.
chris: Reminds me: the starter README shows a snippet using client.embeddings.create(); but the bundled SDK shape was changed in 0.10 -> client.createEmbedding(). New starters are pointing at an older SDK version in package.json, so examples mismatch the installed package.
leo: Oof, SDK parity bug. Did the starter pin @redwood/inference-js?
anya: package.json had "@redwood/inference-js": "^0.9.0". The quickstart snippet uses .embeddings.create which doesn't exist in that version.
tess: That's a bad combo: runtime wasm issues + docs/SDK mismatch = instant onboarding frustration.
chris: Also noticed the starter's fetch wrapper for model downloads retries on network errors but treats 429 as fatal unless the response includes Retry-After. Hosted sandbox gives transient 429s with X-RateLimit-Reset header instead, so downloads fail even though they'd likely succeed after a short wait.
anya: Yeah, on a demo run I saw hundreds of tokenization failures because the model file fetch aborted on a 429.
leo: Actionable plan: 1) Add robust wasm loader with instantiateStreaming -> arrayBuffer fallback + guard for TextEncoder/TextDecoder. 2) Optionally move tokenization to server API by default with a note in README. 3) Pin starter to SDK 0.10.x or update examples to match installed SDK. 4) Update fetch retry to treat 429 as retryable if Retry-After or X-RateLimit-Reset is present, with short backoff window. 5) Add an integration CI job that exercises the starter in a minimal Edge emulation to catch these runtime differences.
tess: I'll volunteer to PR the docs changes and the troubleshooting section: "Edge runtime gotchas (instantiateStreaming, TextEncoder, SDK shape)".
anya: Thanks. I'll open a PR with the wasm loader fix + tiny TextEncoder polyfill and a note to optionally flip tokenization server-side. Will also update package.json to 0.10.2 and adjust examples.
chris: I'll file an infra ticket to add a small edge-emulation step in the starter CI (run a Node 18 script + run the tiny Vercel dev edge server) so we catch these locally before publishing.
leo: For retry logic, we should add a quick unit test that simulates 429 with X-RateLimit-Reset header and ensures the fetcher retries accordingly. I'll add that to the PR too.
devex-bot: New branch created: fix/wasm-edge-sdk-parity (build started)
anya: One more thing: update onboarding checklist for SEs so they verify client.createEmbedding vs client.embeddings.create when copying starter snippets. Tiny docs note could save a lot of time.
tess: Agree. Also add a changelog entry for the starter update so customer-facing SDK docs don't diverge.
anya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/nextjs-llama-starter/pull/12 — includes loader fix, package bump to 0.10.2, retry update, CI job, and README troubleshooting.
chris: Nice. I'll review and help with the CI tests.
leo: Thanks everyone. This should cut down new-hire confusion.
devex-bot: PR #12 merged by anya — changelog: starter: robust wasm loader, pin SDK 0.10.2, respect 429 Retry-After/X-RateLimit-Reset, add edge-emulation CI test.
anya: Closing thread — will follow up if any downstream issues crop up.
